# Apocalypse of Peter — Chapter 5
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Source:** Akhmim Fragment / Ethiopic MS, Apocalypse of Peter 5

---

*[THE HELL-TOUR: Second panel. The punishments multiply.]*

1. I saw more — men and women wallowing in a vast pit while worms consumed their flesh without stopping.

2. "Who are these?" I asked.

3. The angel said: "The moneylenders. The ones who loved their wealth and put all their hope in it — who never looked to God at all."

4. Beyond them stretched an immense region of fire. A whole multitude of men and women burned there, and the stench that rose from them was black and foul and suffocating.

5. They were flung into the fire and came out, and flung in again — beaten between castings by two angels whose only office was punishment.

6. "Who are these?"

7. "The persecutors," the angel said. "Those who hunted the righteous and handed them over to death."

8. Nearby I saw men and women biting through their own tongues in agony. Red-hot irons had been pressed into their eyes and held there.

9. "Who are these?"

10. "False witnesses," he said. "Every false accusation they ever made."

11. Then I saw a pit of mud where men and women stood buried to the knee. These were the fornicators.

12. I saw the murderers — herded into a cramped, lightless corridor with no rest anywhere in it, and enormous serpents coiling and lunging and sinking their fangs in.

13. I saw the robbers, and those who had made it their work to destroy the righteous — all of them flung into a fire that never stopped burning.

14. Among the burning were men and women who had abandoned God altogether. They spun and roasted in the flames, shrieking in voices that cut through everything.

15. The undying worm fed on them. The unquenchable fire held them. And it would always be so.

---
*PNEUMA note: The tour accelerates here — the text moves rapidly from punishment to punishment. The rhythm is rendered as a cascade of horrors. "Worm that does not die / fire unquenchable" (v.15) is preserved as a near-quotation, its scriptural resonance intact.*
